meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 它会扫描所有组,找出带旧版内存文件(如 .seed.md、CLAUDE.md)的组,暂停相关任务,把旧文件迁移到统一的共享内存树中,重新整理索引,并生成迁移报告供确认。
howto.when: 在更新报告了共享内存不兼容之后,或者当你提到“migrate memory”“legacy memory”等关键词,或发现组里还有 .seed.md、CLAUDE.md 等旧版内存时。

say.text: 迁移我们的 legacy 内存
say.note: 它会扫描并迁移旧内存文件。

say.text: 把 CLAUDE.md 合并进共享内存
say.note: 它会移动该文件并整理。

say.text: 迁移 Claude 自动内存
say.note: 它会处理那些旧的内存目录。

howto.what_en: It scans all groups, finds ones with legacy memory files (e.g. .seed.md, CLAUDE.md), pauses related tasks, migrates the files into a unified shared memory tree, reorganizes indexes, and produces a migration report for approval.
howto.when_en: After an update reports a shared-memory breaking change, or when you mention keywords like 'migrate memory', 'legacy memory', or find legacy files such as .seed.md or CLAUDE.md in a group.

say_en.note: It scans and migrates old memory files.

say_en.text: Merge CLAUDE.md into the shared memory tree
say_en.note: It moves and organizes the file.
It handles those old memory directories.
